{"subject":"Claim C021582 past filing limit - write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C021582 (patient PT0185, service code S5125, date of service 2026-09-29, billed $129.60 for 24 units) was submitted on 2026-11-27, 59 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, and editing the claim cannot fix this.

The claim is also a duplicate of C013767, which was already billed and paid or is predicted to be paid. It should not be submitted.

We need a write-off decision on C021582. Please advise as soon as possible so the account can be closed out."}
